name: Precision Packaging Products, Inc.
old_description: Welcome to Precision Packaging Products. You’ve just found the solution to your next custom marketing/packaging project! Our facility located in Tigard, OR is ready to make anywhere from one to 100,000 custom inserts, marketing giveaways, shipping containers or product packages. Send us your specs/ideas and we’ll get working on a quote right away.
about:
Precision Packaging Products, Inc. operates from a facility at 16240 SW 72nd Avenue in Tigard, Oregon. The company has not disclosed its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. It presents itself as a specialist in custom packaging for marketing and shipping projects.

The shop manufactures custom inserts, marketing giveaways, shipping containers, and product packages. It accepts orders from as few as one unit up to 100,000 pieces, covering both prototype and production runs. Details about the facility size, employee count, or specific manufacturing processes such as die cutting or printing are not provided on the website.

The company serves clients in marketing, packaging, and shipping industries who need tailored packaging for promotional campaigns and product distribution. No specific customer names or case studies are listed, and the site does not mention any industry certifications or compliance standards.

Precision Packaging Products highlights custom work as its core specialty and promises quick quote turnaround after receiving specifications. The website does not describe why the company was founded or what specific differentiators it offers beyond low minimum orders and rapid quoting.
